features.description: Backs workflow runtime persistence with an admission-gated Groundwork SQL Server target. Apply schema through Groundwork.Tool before host startup.

options.description: When enabled, safe pending schema operations are applied automatically at startup instead of requiring Groundwork.Tool. Destructive operations are never auto-applied.
options.name: AutoApplySchemaOnStartup

options.description: Retain a bounded shell-local cache of immutable workflow executable artifacts loaded from durable storage, isolated by persistence scope.
options.name: CacheWorkflowExecutables

options.description: SQL Server connection string for the Groundwork runtime document store.
options.name: ConnectionString

options.description: Maximum number of immutable workflow executable artifacts retained by this shell. Must be positive when caching is enabled.
options.name: WorkflowExecutableCacheCapacity
